hooks.name: Check task prerequisites
hooks.description: Verify dependent tasks are completed and approach aligns with roadmap phase

action.prompt: Before starting this task: 1) Verify prerequisite tasks from the dependency graph are completed. 2) Confirm this task belongs to the current roadmap phase. 3) Review coding-standards.md for approach alignment. Proceed with implementation.

hooks.name: Run tests after task completion
hooks.description: Execute test suite after each spec task completes

action.command: npm run test -- --run 2>/dev/null || echo 'Tests not configured yet'
